description: Get available OS images for Search Engine Service (G3/KVM only). The returned image code is the softwareProductCode for ncloud_ses_get_server_specs, ncloud_ses_get_subnet_list_g3 and ncloud_ses_create_cluster_g3. For G2 use ncloud_ses_get_os_products.

generationCode.description: Server generation code. Only G3 (3rd generation) is valid

name: ncloud_ses_get_cluster_server_images
